line-chart-view.description: Smooth or straight line chart with area fill, focusable dots, total tooltip and reference line.

examples.note: Pass immutable series and receive point selections in the log below.
examples.keyboardNote: Dots are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a dot, use the arrow keys to move, Enter to select.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone line chart component.

props.note: Inputs, possible values and defaults. The pointSelect output emits the selected dot.

line-chart-view.title: Line chart
